propositions: sign-review deterministically fails with store-read-failure when untracked files exist in the shared .tickets-tracker, even though the plan-review passed, because generation.collect() at resign.py:146 omits ignore_untracked and defaults to strict git status --porcelain that includes untracked files

generation.collect() is called at four sites without ignore_untracked: resign.py (hard-fail signing), orchestrator.py (silent fallback to expensive full LLM re-review), and attest.py at two locations (fallback attestation path failures)

untracked files in the shared .tickets-tracker represent normal transient state from concurrent session atomic writes, not crash debris, so the strict check causes cross-session race conditions that scale with concurrency

the fix tolerates untracked files by passing ignore_untracked=True because these are reads that fingerprint committed head state which untracked files cannot change, while tracked-dirty state must still fail to maintain signing guarantees
the missing ignore_untracked parameter is a regression: the identical bug class was already fixed in commit 1475e2868 (d7cb-22ae) at other call sites and has regression tests asserting the contract
